verses.text: This is the book of the words of Tobit, the son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, of the tribe of Naphtali, who was of the city of Gabael, which is situated in the region of Galilee.

And he said: "It is from the region of Galilee, beyond the territory of Asher, that it has come, from the place called Kedesh, on the right side, during the reign of the king of Assyria, in the days of the king named Amaneser."

sections.title: The good life of the warrior.

verses.text: I have walked in the way of righteousness and truth throughout my life; and many brethren and kin have come with me to the city of Assyria and to Nineveh, for I have made many offerings.

And I, being a child, dwelt in my land with the children of Israel, all the descendants of my father, the descendants of Nefthalim; and all Israel shall serve her, for the Lord chose from all the tribes of Israel the exalted house of the temple for all generations, from the time of its foundation and sanctification, and it shall depart from Jerusalem.
And all the people of the land worshipped the idol that is called Damali; and all the descendants of my father, the descendants of Nefthalim, joined themselves with them.

But I, according to the everlasting commandment, as it is written for all Israel, would often go to Jerusalem on the days of the feasts; and in the beginning, I would take the first fruits of my flocks and offer them to the sons of Aaron, the priests, at the sanctuary.
I would give all the first fruits and the first ten to the sons of Aaron who serve in Jerusalem; but the second ten I would sell; and I would bring the offerings yearly to Jerusalem.
And the third ten I would give to the poor, as my mother Deborah commanded; for my father and mother have forsaken me in their poverty.
When I reached the age of maturity, I took a wife from the daughters of my people; and I begot Tobiah.

sections.title: The Book of Jonah: To go to Nineveh.

verses.text: And all the brethren and the elders, when they were gathered unto Nineveh, said unto the people of the land, "Do not eat of the food of the Gentiles."
But I, for my part, kept my body that I might not partake of the food of the Gentiles.
I have thought upon the Lord God with all my heart.
And the Lord granted me honor and wealth before Ameneser; and He made me a great man and lifted me up.
And I went unto Media; and in Media, I kept watch over the ten measures of the brother Gabriel who was in Ragis.
And Ameneser, when he died, left his son Sanakrem; and his deeds were evil; and he did me wrong; therefore, henceforth, I could not go unto Media.

sections.title: The good work of the soldier.

verses.text: In the days of Aminezer, I made many offerings for my brethren.
I also gave my heart to the afflicted, and my soul to those who were in distress. When I beheld a dead man among my kin, cast beneath the wall of Nineveh, I was in mourning.
King Senakereb, when he returned from Judah, I was in mourning for those whom he had slain. For he was fierce and had slain many. The king sought their heads, but I found them not.
And one man from Nineveh went forth, as if to bury them, and he conspired with the king; and I was taken captive. When I knew that they sought to slay me, I fled and hid myself.
In my captivity, all my wealth was taken from me; there was none left for me, save what my wife Hannah and my son Tobiah had provided.

Until both my sons were slain, I did not depart from my house for fifty-five days, even until they went to the mountains of Ararat. My son was in mourning for his brother, and the son of my brother, the son of Anahiel, was in mourning in his father's house and in all their labors.
And Akiahikros was my name; and I returned to Nineveh. Akiahikros was the guardian of my seal and the possessions of my house. And he mourned for his brother.

And when I returned to my land, my wife Hannah and my son Tobiah met me. On the seventh day of the feast of the dedication of the altar, they did good things for me; and I was glad because I had been seated.

And when I saw that the food was exceedingly abundant, I said to my son, “Go and bring the poor who have been gathered by our brethren. For I remember the Lord. Behold, I will also keep watch over you.”
And when I returned, he said to me, “My father! I have found a man who is of our kin, and he is fallen in the market.”
And I arose without delay; and I went to one house until the sun set.
And returning to my house, I mourned and ate my meal with sorrow.
And I remembered the saying, “Your feasts shall turn to mourning, and your joy shall turn to lamentation.”
After this, I departed; and when the sun had set, I went and buried him.
And the neighbors were speaking to me, saying, “Will this man not fear, saying that he will be punished for this deed? For the king will surely punish those who have been slain.”

sections.title: How the eye of the warrior has been darkened.

verses.text: And on that night, I returned from the grave; for I was in sorrow beneath the old tree; yet my eyes were opened.

And upon the old tree, I knew not that there were birds; and while my face was revealed, those birds cast a shadow upon my eyes; and my eyes became dim and troubled; and I went unto the Lord of healing, yet there was none to heal me; until I journeyed unto Elmadiah, I was beset by Akhiakros.
Hannah also served in the house of women.
And she sent unto her mothers; and they gave her a gift of a dove; and they also adorned her with a ram's fleece.
And when she came unto me, she began to cry; and I said unto her, "Where is this ram from? If it be from the flock, let it return unto its shepherds. For that which is lost cannot be a meal."

And she said unto me, "They gave me a dove;" but I believed her not; and I spoke with her as I would with her masters; and she answered, "Where is thy prayer and thy offerings? Behold, all that is above thee is known."

sections.title: The Prayer of the Warrior

verses.text: After this, I was troubled in my heart; I did not cease to pray.
Thus I said, "O Lord, in all Thy works, in mercy and in judgment, Thou art indeed righteous; O Lord, Thou dost govern the world in truth."
Consider me; look upon me; for in my own sin and in my transgressions against Thee, do not let me be forsaken because of the sins of my forefathers.
For the purpose of destruction and for the purpose of ruin, Thou hast made us; in all the world and within it, we have become a reproach and a derision among the nations.
Now, indeed, Thy true judgment is great; let my sin and the sin of my forefathers be forgiven; for we have not heeded Thy commandments, nor have we walked in truth before Thee.

Now, before Thee, let that which brings me joy be done by me; for it is better for me to die than to live, and in death I shall be at rest; let me command my soul, which the earth shall receive. For I have heard of the burdens of deceit and of oppression, and my sorrow has increased upon me; that I may find rest from my affliction, and that I may go to the eternal place, let me command; and let not Thy face turn away from me.
And on that day, in the region of Media, the daughter of Raguel, Sarah, was found among the servants of her father.

She was betrothed to seven men, and as a man and a woman do not separate, the evil demon named Asmodeus had slain them; and thus she said, "Do you not know that your husbands are dead? Behold, seven have come to you; and of them, none has been joined to you."
Therefore, what shall we say concerning them? They are dead, and go with them; from you, whether male or female child, do not look until the end of the world.

This also caused her great distress until she prayed; she said, "I am alone for my father and my mother; and if I do this, I shall be burdened; and I shall carry their shame, and my body shall be in anguish as I go to the grave."

sections.title: The Prayer of Sarah

verses.text: In the corner of the window she prayed, saying, “O Lord, Thou art my Creator; blessed art Thou; Thy name is holy and glorious, and may it be praised forever; all Thy works are glorious forever.”
O Lord, even now I have given mine eyes and my face unto Thee.
Therefore, do not let me be ensnared by the burdens of this world, for I am not of this world.
Concerning all the sins committed with a man, I have remained pure; O Lord, Thou knowest.

In the land where I was brought low, I have not forgotten my name nor the name of my father; for I am but one to my father. I have no brother; I have no wife to whom I may cling, nor any near relative; for my seven brothers have perished, and now why should I live? If thou dost not wish to slay me, then turn thy face towards me; and let me not be burdened with the burdens of this world.
And their prayers were heard before the Lord, in the presence of His greatness.

And He sent Raphael to heal them; to protect them from the evil eye, and to give the daughter of Raguel, Sarah, to the son of Tobit, Tobiah, that he might take her as a wife, and to cast out the evil spirit Asmodeus, for Tobiah was to inherit her. And in that time, Tobit returned and entered into his house; and the daughter of Raguel, Sarah, descended from her chamber.

sections.title: The counsel given to his son by the father.

verses.text: In that day, the sword shall come upon the region of Media, for the silver that was set aside for Gabriel shall be brought forth.
And he thought within himself, saying, “Behold, I shall die; why should I not speak to my son Tobiah, that he may not be silent when I am dead?”
And he said, “My son, at the time of your death, honor your mother; keep her, and throughout your life, exalt her; and do for her what she desires; do not grieve her.”
My son, consider that you have received much trouble in the womb; and when you die, let me be buried in one grave with you.
My son! In all your days, remember your Creator; do not be led astray by sin and the commandments; throughout your life, do righteousness, and do not walk in the path of destruction.
Righteousness shall be established in all your ways, and in all the work you do, it shall be established; and righteousness shall be established for all who do it.
From your wealth, give alms; and when you give alms, do not let your heart be troubled; do not turn your face away from the poor, and God will not turn His face away from you.
Give alms according to your ability.
Even if it is little, do not hesitate to give; for giving alms is a good deed that will be remembered.
Almsgiving shall deliver from death in the day of trouble; and it shall preserve you from going into darkness.
A good gift is in the sight of the Most High for all who do it.

"My son! Keep thyself from the company of the unworthy; take a wife from among the daughters of thy fathers, and let her be of thy kindred. If she be not of thy time, do not take her from a distant kin. For we are a lineage that began from ancient times, from the prophets, from Noah and Abraham, from Isaac and Jacob; consider, my son, that all take wives from their own lineage, as it was blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land as it was promised."

Now, my son, love thy wife; let not thy heart be troubled by the sons and daughters of thy kin; take a wife from among them. For pride brings forth a fall, and there are many afflictions; and where there is pride, there is trouble; and great poverty is there; for she is the mother of all strife.
All that is thine shall not be diminished; give it in due time. For if thou givest unto the Lord, thy reward shall be multiplied; know thyself, and be wise in all thy work and conduct.
Do not do unto others what thou would not have done unto thyself; do not drink wine for the sake of drunkenness; do not walk in the streets with the wicked.
Give of thy bread to the hungry, and of thy garments to the naked; do good unto all that are in need.
Bury not thy bread upon the grave of the righteous; but do not give it to the wicked.
Seek counsel from the wise; do not despise the counsel of those who would guide thee.

At all times, give thanks unto thy Creator, the Lord; let thy path be straight before Him, and pray unto Him; in all thy works and in all thy ways, He shall establish thee. All good things come from Him; apart from Him, all counsel of the ungodly is in vain. He shall deliver those who are beloved; and as He is beloved, so shall He be. Now, my son, consider my command; let it not depart from thy heart.

sections.title: The offering for Gebael was given in accordance with the money he provided.

verses.text: "Now in the region of Media, I shall speak unto you concerning the ten pieces of silver, which I have reserved for you, O son of Ragis, the son of Gebael, for the sake of the promise I have made unto you."

"My son! Fear not, for you have risen from poverty. The poor shall receive much blessing from you; if you fear the Lord and turn away from all sin, and if you perform that which brings joy to the Lord before Him, abundant blessings shall dwell with you."

sections.title: And the angel Raphael went forth with Tobiah.

verses.text: ጦብያም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ፥ “አባቴ! ያዘዝኸኝን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ።
ነገር ግን ከማላውቀው ሰው ያን ብር መቀበል እንዴት እችላለሁ?”
እርሱም ደብዳቤ ሰጠው፤ እንዲህም አለው፥ “ከአንተ ጋር የሚሄድ ሰው ፈልግ፤ እኔም በሕይወት ሳለሁ ደመወዙን እሰጠዋለሁ፤ ሄደህም ያንን ብር ተቀበል።”
እርሱም ሰውን ሊፈልግ ሄዶ መልአኩን ሩፋኤልን አገኘው፤ ነገር ግን መልአክ እንደ ሆነ አላወቀም።
እርሱም አለው፥ “ሀገሩን ታውቅ እንደ ሆነ ወደ ሜዶን ክፍል ወደ ራጊስ ከኔ ጋራ መሄድ ትችላለህን?”
መልአኩም እንዲህ አለው፥ “ከአንተ ጋር እሄዳለሁ፤ መንገዱንም ዐውቃለሁ፤ በገባኤልም ዘንድ ነበርሁ።”
ጦብያም፥ “ላባቴ እስክነግረው ድረስ ቈየኝ” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “ሂድ፤ አትቈይ” አለው፤ ለአባቱም፥ “ከእኔ ጋር የሚሄድ እነሆ አገኘሁ” አለው። እርሱም፥ “ከማን ወገን እንደ ሆነ፥ ካንተም ጋራ ለመሄድ የታመነ እንደ ሆነ ዐውቅ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ጥራው” አለው።
ጠራውና ገባ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም እጅ ተነሣሡ።
ጦቢትም፥ “አንተ ወንድሜ! ከማን ወገን ነህ? ከወዴትስ ሀገር ነህ?” አለው።

The angel said, “Will you not inquire about my brother and my country? Or will you give me the value of that which I would go with your son?” And Tobit replied, “I love you, my brother, because I know your lineage and your name.”
He said, “I am indeed your brother, the great Ananiah, the son of Azariah.”

Tobit said, “Are you well, my brother? I am inquiring about your family and your country, for I am concerned for you; but truly, you are from a blessed lineage; and I know the sons of the great Semion, Ananiah and Itiah; we were to go together to Jerusalem; we were to take our tents and the tent of our mother; but we did not commit sin against our fathers.”
“But you, my brother, are from a blessed household; yet tell me, what shall we give you? Shall we give you one drachma each day? Or shall your food be with my son?”
“When you return in peace, I shall add to your drachma,” thus they concluded.

Tobiah said, “As you go, prepare yourselves for the journey.” And his son made ready for the way; and his father said, “Go with this man; may the God who dwells in heaven guide your way; may the angel go with you.” And they both departed and his other son followed them.
His mother Hannah wept, and she said to Tobiah, “Why do you send my son? He is the one who goes out before us and enters, and he is not a burden in our hands.”
“May the curse be upon my son!”
“May the Lord, who has given us a place to dwell, be sufficient for us.”
Tobit said, “Sister, do not grieve; he shall return in peace; and you shall see him with your own eyes.”
For a good angel shall go before him, and he shall guard the way, and he shall return in peace.
And Hannah fulfilled her vow.

sections.title: And the angel and Tobiah went to the house of Gabael, and they found a great fish.

verses.text: And as they journeyed, they came to Tigris and the evening fell upon them; and there they rested.
And that child went to bathe; and from the water a fish arose and swam about; and that child went forth to catch it.
The angel said, “That fish is caught”; and that child seized the fish and brought it forth to the house of the father.
The angel said, “Catch the fish, and take its heart and liver, and its gall; and keep them safe.”
And that child did as the angel commanded; and he kept the fish, and both of them went forth and came to the house of the father.
And that child said to the angel, “You, my brother Azariah! What is the heart, the liver, and the gall of this fish for?”

And the angel said, “The heart and the liver: if there be a wicked spirit that troubles a man, or if there be an unclean spirit that troubles a woman, those shall drive them away from before that person; and if it be a woman, they shall drive her away; and thereafter they shall not remain.”
But the gall shall be for the healing of the eyes of a man who is blind; and he shall see.”
And when they drew near to Raguel,

the angel said, “You, my brother! Today we shall abide in the house of Raguel; for he is your kinsman; and he has a daughter; and her name is Sara; and I will speak concerning her, that she may be given to you as a wife; for she is destined for you.”
Thou art, O Lord, from everlasting; and thy daughter is indeed of a steadfast heart.

Now hear me; I shall speak unto her father; for when we return from the land of our enemies, we shall hold a feast of marriage; for it is written in the law of Moses that she shall not be given to another man, lest she be despised; and if she should die, she was beloved; for she shall surely come unto thee, more than unto any man.
And that child said unto the angel, “Thou art my brother Azariah! I have heard that this girl shall be given to seven men; all shall perish in the time of the marriage.”

Now I am alone to my father; and when I entered unto her, I feared lest I should die, for I dread that my father’s and my mother’s life should be brought down to the grave because of me; for there is no other child to be buried for them.

And the angel said, “Dost thou not remember the word which thy father hath spoken concerning thy wife from the days of old? Now hear me, my brother; let not our matter trouble thee; for this night she shall be given unto thee as a wife from the days of old.”
And when thou enterest into the house of the bride, take the sweet wine; and from this fish, add to thy heart and to thy soul.

And our matter shall be fulfilled in the time of the marriage; for it shall not return unto eternity. And when thou enterest into her, let not thy heart be troubled; cry unto the Lord, and He shall have mercy upon you; He shall say unto you, “Fear not; from the beginning I have prepared her for thee; and thou shalt be delivered; she shall go with thee; and as she beareth children, I shall speak unto thee.” And Tobiah, hearing these words, was greatly troubled; and his heart was drawn unto her, and they came unto the house of the bride.

sections.title: And the angel and Tobiah came unto the house of Raguel.

verses.text: And they came to the house of Raguel; and Sarah received them with joy, and thus they also rejoiced in her. And they brought them into the house.
And Raguel said to his wife, “This child is wonderful; he resembles a mighty warrior from ancient times.”
And Raguel said, “Brothers, from whence are ye?” And they answered him, “We are the children of the captives of Nineveh.”
And Raguel said unto them, “Do ye know the warrior?” And they said, “We know him.” And he said, “Is he alive? Is he well?”
And they said, “Yea, he is well.” And Tobiah said, “He is my father.”
Then Raguel arose and embraced him.
“Thou art indeed the son of a good man,” he said, and he wept; for the eyes of Tobiah were as if they had been blinded. And the eyes of Tobiah wept when he heard the voice.

His wife also wept, and Sarah his daughter-in-law embraced them; and they received them with joy, and they prepared a feast for them. And Tobiah said to Azariah, “Speak thou, my brother, of that which thou hast seen; let it be known.”
And Raguel, hearing Tobiah speak, began to converse with him, saying, “Drink, and be glad.”
“For thou art worthy for my daughter, and thou also shalt be worthy.”

And I will declare the truth unto thee; this daughter of mine hath been given unto seven men; and as they enter unto her by night, they shall die. Nevertheless, let it be that thou shalt rejoice once.” Tobiah said, “As for the matter, do not cease to speak unto me until thou hast finished; and concerning my matter, do not cease to speak unto me until thou hast concluded it, for in this I shall not relent.”
And Raguel said, “From this time forth, according to the law, let her be given; for thou art her brother, and she is thy sister; may the Lord God grant unto you that which is good.”
And the son called Sarah; and he took her hand and gave her to Tobiah to be his wife, saying, “Behold, according to the law of Moses, let her be given; and let her go unto thy father's house.”
And his wife called out to him, and she took a parchment and wrote, and she sent it.
And after this, they began to eat.
And she called out, saying, “Thou, my sister, prepare another chamber; and let her go there.”
And as she said, so she did; and she brought her there; and she wept for her child.
“Concerning this sorrow of thine, may the Lord of heaven and earth grant thee joy as thou dost desire,” she said.

sections.title: The departure of our father from Sarah.

verses.text: And they took refuge, and in the time of their distress, Tobiah approached her.
And when he entered unto her, he remembered the words of Raphael; he was troubled, and he took the fish, and thereafter, he removed the heart and the liver from it.
And her shame fled away, and she ran until she reached the upper region of Egypt. And that angel bound her shame.

sections.title: The Prayer of Tobiah

verses.text: And both, at the time they were prepared, Tobiah arose from his bed and said, "Sister, arise; let us pray to the Lord that He may have mercy upon us."
And Tobiah began to say, "O Lord, God of our fathers, blessed art Thou; and blessed be Thy holy name; and let it be praised forever. All the heavens and all Thy creation shall praise Thee."

Thou art He who created our father Adam; and Thou didst give him a helper and a companion, and from these came the race of mankind; and Thou saidst, 'It is not good for man to be alone; let us make him a helper suitable for him.'
Now, my sister, it is right that we should be united, for it is not for mourning; therefore, let us pray together that we may attain mercy before the Lord, and let Him send us His pardon.
And she said to him, "Amen."
And they both spent that night together.
And after this, Raguel arose and went; and he said, "Perhaps he will die," and he went to the grave.
And Raguel returned to his house.
His wife said to him, "Let one of our children be sent to see how he is, for if he has died, no one will know."
And their son went and broke the seal of the grave; and they both fell asleep.
He returned and spoke to them, saying that he was well.

And Raguel blessed the Lord, and he said, "O Lord, Thou art the one who is to be blessed; for all the blessings that we have received are from Thee. Thy righteous ones: in all the works they have done, they have given thanks unto Thee; Thy angels and all whom Thou hast chosen shall give thanks unto Thee forever."
I have been made glad, for Thou art the one who is to be blessed; as I have not been treated with disdain, yet according to Thy mercy, Thou hast dealt bountifully with me.
Thou art blessed; for Thou hast shown mercy to the two orphans, that they may pass their days in safety and joy; for by Thy goodness, O Lord, hast Thou provided for them.
And after this, Raguel commanded his servants to prepare that tomb.

sections.title: The Feast of the Harvest

verses.text: And after this, he made for them a feast of fourteen days.
And Raguel said, "Let the feast of fourteen days be completed, and let Tobias not depart until it is finished."
And after this, he went to take the full measure of the money, and he went safely to his father; but he instructed that he and his wife should take the remainder after their death.

sections.title: Raphael received the money of the offering as it was given.

verses.text: Tobiah called upon Raphael, saying thus:

"You, my brother Azariah, take with you two goats and a young ram, and go to the region of Media, to the city of Rages, to the house of Gabael; and bring back the silver. And also, prepare for him the feast of the wedding."
"Let it not be that the feast of the wedding should pass by without my presence, for I have prayed for it."
"But my father will count the days; and if he sees that I have not returned, he will be grieved."
And Raphael went; and he came to the house of Gabael, and he delivered the letter; and he brought forth those things as if they were taken from the treasure, and he gave them to Raphael.
And they went on their journey in unity; and they reached the wedding; and when Tobiah brought forth that silver, Raphael was revealed to him.

sections.title: The children of Tobiah were as those who were troubled.

verses.text: His father was indeed troubled, for the day was drawing near. The appointed time had not yet come, and he was in distress during that time.
Thus he spoke, “Perhaps behold, shall my son be delivered? Or is it that Gabriel, who brings forth death, shall not be found?”
He was exceedingly distressed.
And his wife said, “My son has died; therefore, this matter is grievous.”
And while she spoke thus, she began to weep, saying, “If my eyes do not behold the light, may my son not be taken from me, for I am not grieved.”
And he said, “Be silent; do not be troubled; he is well.”

And she replied, “You also be silent; do not comfort me; my son has died.” And she wept, for she would always walk in the street where he had gone. For the festival of the harvest was approaching, and she would not go out until the day of the festival was completed, mourning for her son, Tobiah, and during the day she would not eat, and at night she would not be silent.

sections.title: And Tobiah and Sarah returned unto their house.

verses.text: And after this, Tobiah said to Raguel, “Now therefore, grant me favor; for my father and mother have forsaken hope, and thus they will not do me any good if they see me.”
And she said, “Stay with me, that I may tell your tidings, for I will go to your father.”
And Tobiah said, “It shall not be; but I will go to my father, that you may grant me favor.”
And Raguel arose and gave his wife Sarah, and the portion of the money, and the servants, and the cattle, and he gave them freely.

And he said, “Children, may the Lord of heaven do good to you before I die,” and he spoke to his son thus: “Honor your mothers; for these are your mothers; and we will listen to the good things from you.” And he also said to Tobiah, “You, my brother, whom I love, may the Lord of heaven grant you joy before my daughter Sarah, and may He bless you in the sight of God, and may your path be made straight. Behold, I have given you my daughter in marriage; do not be grieved.”
And after this, Tobiah went; and he gave thanks to God; for He had directed his way. And Raguel and his wife gave thanks; and they went on their way, and they drew near to Nineveh.
And after this, Raphael said to Tobiah, "Do you not know how your father has been forsaken?"
And go before your wife and prepare the house.
Let the fish of this kind be taken;” and he went with them, following after them.
But Hannah sat by the wayside, looking to see her son.
And when he came, she saw him; and she said to her husband, "Behold, your son has come, and the man who went with him has arrived."

sections.title: The eye of the warrior is like the dawn.

verses.text: And Raphael said, “I know that your father’s eyes shall be opened;
but you, indeed, shall bring the blindness upon your father’s eyes; at the time of his blindness, his eyes shall be healed; and he shall see clearly.”
And Hannah took her son by the hand, saying, “My son, if I should lose you, let it be so,” and both of them wept.
And Tobit went out to the door; he was troubled; and his son ran to his father.
And the eyes of his father were opened at that moment, and he said, “My father, behold, as you have spoken, so shall it be.”
And at that time, his eyes were restored.
And he saw clearly, and he beheld his son; and he took him by the hand and embraced him.
And he said, “O Lord, blessed art Thou, for Thou hast remembered us; Thy name shall be praised forever; and all Thy holy angels are blessed; for Thou hast had mercy upon me.”
And behold, I have seen my son Tobiah,” and after this, his son entered rejoicing; and he told his father all the great things that had been done for him in Media.
And Tobiah, rejoicing, went in and embraced his wife; and he gave thanks to God in Nineveh; and as he went, the people saw him and marveled, saying, “How is it that we see him?”

Tobit, however, gave thanks before them, saying, "Blessed be God, for He has shown mercy upon us. And when Tobit arrived at the house of his son, he exclaimed, 'My son! Truly, you have returned in peace!' And may God be praised who has brought you back to us; may He bless your father and your mother." And there was great joy among all the brethren who dwelt in Nineveh.
And Akikaros came; and the son of his brother, Nasanbos, also came.
And for seven days, they celebrated the feast of the wedding with joy.

sections.title: The value of the service appointed for Raphael.

verses.text: And after this, Tobit called his son, saying, "My son, see the man who has come with you; look upon his countenance, for he is worthy to be joined with you."
And Tobiah said to his father, "Though I bring back the money that I have received, there is no harm in giving it to him."
"And I have returned to you in peace, for my wife has been taken from me; and I have brought back the silver to you; and thus I have taken you."
And his father said, "You have spoken the truth."
And the angel called them, saying, "Go in peace, and take with you all that you have brought back."

And Raphael called them both, and said, "Bless God; for He has given you good things; and offer Him praise; and give thanks for all the good He has done for you; and let all men know of His works; bless God; and speak of His name; and declare the works of the Lord with honor; and do not cease to bless Him."
To reveal the secrets of the kingdom is fitting, but to declare the works of the Lord with honor is necessary; and do good works, lest you fall into trouble.
Prayer with fasting, with almsgiving and righteousness, is good; better is a little with truth than much gain with iniquity; and better is it to give alms than to hoard gold.
Almsgiving delivers from death, and it will purge away every sin; and those who do righteousness and almsgiving will fill their own lives with life.
But those who are greedy will lose their lives.
“እነሆ፥ ነገሩን ሁሉ ከእናንተ አልሰውርም፤ የመንግሥትን ምሥጢር ሊሰውሩት የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ግን በክብር ሊገልጡት መልካም እንደ ሆነ እነግራችኋለሁ።
እነሆ፥ አንተና ምራትህ ሣራ በጸለያችሁ ጊዜ የልመናችሁን መታሰቢያ እኔ በቅዱሱ ፊት አቀረብሁ፤ አንተም ሬሳ በቀበርህ ጊዜ ያንጊዜ እኔ ካንተ ጋራ ነበርሁ።
ቸል ባላልህ ጊዜ፥ ምሳህንም ትተህ በተነሣህ ጊዜ፥ ሬሳንም ትቀብር ዘንድ በሄድህ ጊዜ፥ በጎ ሥራን መሥራትንም ባልዘነጋህ ጊዜ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ።
አሁንም፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር አንተን አድንህ ዘንድ፥ ምራትህ ሣራንም ከኀዘኗ አረጋጋት ዘንድ ላከኝ።
የቅዱሳንን ጸሎት ከሚያሳርጉ፥ በገናናውና በቅዱሱ ጌትነት ፊት ከሚያቀርቡ ሰባቱ ቅዱሳን መላእክት አንዱ መልአክ እኔ ሩፋኤል ነኝ” አላቸው።
ይህንም ሰምተው ሁለቱ ደነገጡ፤ ፈርተዋልምና በግምባራቸው ወደቁ።
መልአኩም እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “አትፍሩ፤ ነገር ግን አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩት፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ፈጽማችሁ አመስግኑት፤
ምስጋና ለእኔ አይገባኝምና፥ ነገር ግን የአምላካችሁ ፈቃድ አመጣኝ፤ ስለዚህም በዘመናት ሁሉ ለዘለዓለሙ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት።
እኔም ተገለጥሁላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እይታን አያችሁ እንጂ ከእናንተ ጋር አልበላሁም፤ አልጠጣሁምም።
አሁንም በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ ወደ ላከኝም ወደ ላይ እወጣለሁና ይህን ሁሉ በመጽሐፍ ጻፉት” አለ።
And at that time he arose and went; thereafter he was not seen.
And the angel of the Lord, because he had revealed himself to them, believed in all the works of the Lord, which are marvelous and wondrous.

sections.title: A tribute offered unto the Lord God is a thanksgiving.

verses.text: And Tobit wrote a book of praises; and he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for He is the living God, and His kingdom is for all ages."
He shall have mercy; He shall say, "Forgive," and He shall bring down to Sheol; He shall also bring forth; and there is none who can deliver from His hand.
O children of Israel, all of you, He has redeemed you in the midst of all nations.
And there He revealed His glory to you; and before all men, honor Him; for He is our Lord, and He is God, our Father, forever.
In our sins He shall have mercy upon us; and He shall say, "Forgive us," for He shall gather us from among all nations.

"In His presence, you shall serve truth with all your heart and with all your soul; and when you return to Him, He shall return to you. His face shall not be turned away from you. You shall see what He has done with you. With all your heart and with all your soul, trust in Him; bless the righteous Lord; and in the land where you dwell, exalt the King of the ages; and I shall trust in the land where I dwell; and I shall speak of His mercy to the sinners and to all nations. O you sinners, return to Him and serve truth before Him; and who knows if He shall do good for you?"
I shall exalt my Creator; and my body shall praise the Lord God of heaven.
And I shall speak of His glory to all.
"O holy city, Jerusalem, shall you not be consumed by the sins of your children? And again, shall the children who are in distress be comforted?"

Be diligent in good works for the Lord; and let your heart rejoice in serving the King of the ages; and there shall be joy among those who have been redeemed. And in every generation, all who are called shall love you for your sake.

"Many nations shall come from afar unto the name of the Creator, the Lord God; they shall bring unto the King of Heaven their offerings, and all generations shall give thanks unto Thee; they shall offer praises unto Thy name."
"All who seek Thee are blessed; but all who love Thee are counted as blessed for eternity."
"It is a joy to the children of the righteous; O Lord, united in oneness, they shall give thanks unto Thee, their Lord, for they are beloved of Thee; and in Thy peace, they shall rejoice."
"All who mourn for Thy suffering are blessed; for they shall not forsake Thy glory, and in Thee, they shall rejoice; for eternity shall bring them joy."
"My body shall yet give thanks unto the King, the Lord God."
"Jerusalem shall be adorned with a glorious crown; her walls shall be built with precious stones and adorned with fine gold, and her gates shall be made of pure gold."
"The gates of Jerusalem shall be constructed with fine linen, with the finest of fabrics and adorned with precious stones."
"In all her streets, they shall cry, 'Hallelujah'; and as they give thanks, they shall say, 'The Lord endures forever, even unto eternity shall we give Him praise.'"

sections.title: The final counsel of the warrior.

verses.text: ከዚህ በኋላ ጦቢት ከመጸለይ ዝም አለ፤
ዐይኑም በጠፋ ጊዜ አምሳ ስምንት ዓመት ሆኖት ነበር። ከስምንት ዓመት በኋላም አየ፤ ምጽዋትም መጸወተ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራትንም ጨመረ፤ በእርሱም አመነ።
ፈጽሞ አረጀ፤ ልጁንና የልጁንም ልጆች ጠራቸው፤ እንዲህም አላቸው፥ “አርጅቻለሁና፥ ለሞትም ደርሻለሁና ልጆችህን አምጣቸው።”

ልጄ፥ ወደ ሜዶን ሂድ፤ ትጠፋ ዘንድ እንዳላት ነቢዩ ዮናስ በነነዌ የተናገረውን ነገር ሁሉ አውቃለሁና፤ በሜዶን ግን እስከ ዘመኑ ድረስ ሰላም ይሆናል። ወንድሞቻችንም ከተባረከች ምድር ሁሉ ወደየሀገሩ ይበተኑ ዘንድ አላቸው፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም ምድረ በዳ ትሆናለች፤ በእርስዋም ያለ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይቃጠላል፤ እስከ ዘመኑም ድረስ ምድረ በዳ ይሆናል።
ዳግመኛም እግዝአብሔር ይቅር ብሎ ወደ ሀገራቸው ይመልሳቸዋል፤ ማደሪያው ቤተ መቅደስንም ይሠራሉ፤ የዘመኑ ቍጥር እስከሚፈጸም ነው እንጂ እንደ ቀድሞው አይደለም፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ከተማረኩበት ይመለሳሉ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በክብር ይሠሯታል፤ በእርሷም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት እስከ ልጅ ልጅ ዘመን ድረስ በዕብነ በረድ ይሠራሉ።
አሕዛብም ሁሉ በእውነት ወደ እርሱ ይመለሳሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈሩታል፤ ጣዖቶቻቸውንም ይጥላሉ።
አሕዛብ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑታል። ሕዝቡም በእርሱ ያምናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ወገኖቹን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸዋል። በእውነትና በቅንነት እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ለወንድሞቻቸውም ቸርነትን ያደርጋሉ።
“ልጄ ሆይ! አሁንም ከነነዌ ውጣ፤ ነቢዩ ዮናስ የተናገረው ነገር በግድ ይደረጋልና።
አንተ ግን ትእዛዙንና ሕጉን ጠብቅ፤ ይቅር ባይም ሁን፤ በጎ ይደረግልህ ዘንድ እውነትን ውደድ።

አክብረህ ቅበረኝ፤ እናትህንም ከእኔ ጋር ቅበራት። ልጄ፥ በነነዌ አትቈይ። ሐማ በዘመድህ በአኪአክሮስ ያደረገውን፥ ከብርሃን ወደ ጨለማ እንዳገባው፥ ፍዳውንም እንደ ተቀበለ፥ አኪአክሮስም እንደ ዳነ እይ። እርሱ ግን ፍዳውን ተቀበለ፤ እርሱ ወደ ጨለማ ወረደ። ምናሴ ምጽዋትን አደረገ፤ እውነትንም አደረገ፤ ከመከሩበት ከሞት መቅሠፍትም ዳነ። ሐማ ግን በዚያች ወጥመድ ወደቀና ሞተ።

sections.title: The death of the warrior and his wife.

verses.text: “አሁንም ልጄ፥ ምጽዋት የምታደርገውን እይ፤ ከሞት ታድናለች፤ ታጸድቃለችም።” ጦቢትም ይህን ተናግሮ ሞተ፤ ባልጋው ላይ ሳለም ነፍሱ ከሥጋው ተለየች። መቶ አምሳ ስምንት ዐመትም ሆኖት ነበር። በክብርም ቀበሩት፤
እናቱ ሐናም በሞተች ጊዜ ካባቱ ጋራ ቀበራት። ጦብያም ከሚስቱና ከልጆቹ ጋር አማቱ ራጉኤል ወዳለበት ወደ ባጥና ሄደ።
ራጉኤልና ሚስቱ አድናም አርጅተው ሞቱ። አማቶቹንም አክብሮ ቀበራቸው። ገንዘባቸውንም ሁሉ ወረሰ። የአባቱን የጦቢትን ገንዘብም ወረሰ።
ጦብያም በመቶ ሃያ ሰባት ዓመቱ ሞተ፤ የሜዶን ክፍል በምትሆን በባጥናም ተቀበረ።
አባቱም እንደ ነገረው ሳይሞት የነነዌን ጥፋት ሰማ። ናቡከደነፆርና አሕሻዊሮስም የነነዌን ጥፋት ሰምተው ደስ አላቸው።
